list gg.control: control: jump to the top (the page itself)
list gg.why: Jumping to the top of a list of 2,400 messages costs the app the layout of the rows it lands on, and the most of what `gg` costs (the control row is the page setting scrollTop itself); `gg` also moves the cursor row after the jump.

list G.control: control: jump to the bottom (the page itself)
list G.why: Jumping to the bottom of a list of 2,400 messages costs the app the layout of the rows it lands on, and the most of what `G` costs (the control row is the page setting scrollTop itself); `G` also moves the cursor row after the jump.

list o.control: control: open the thread (the page itself)
list o.why: Opening a thread costs the app a render of its pane, even when the thread is already open and only its tab comes forward: some 75 ms of script on a two-core machine (the control row is the page asking the host to open the same thread itself). `o` adds the plugin's own work after the frames measured, landing at the thread's end.

thread gg.control: control: jump to the top (the page itself)
thread gg.why: Jumping to the top of the 80-reply thread costs the app the layout of the rows it lands on (the control row is the page setting scrollTop itself); `gg` also moves the cursor row.

thread G.control: control: jump to the bottom (the page itself)
thread G.why: Jumping to the bottom of the 80-reply thread costs the app the layout of the rows it lands on (the control row is the page setting scrollTop itself).

settings l: open the next section.control: control: open the next section (the page itself)
settings l: open the next section.why: The host renders a whole settings section anew when another is opened (the control row is the page clicking the next section itself). The row presses h, j and l, so it carries two more key presses.

settings l: open the section before.control: control: open the section before (the page itself)
settings l: open the section before.why: The same as the next section: the host renders a whole settings section anew when another is opened (the control row is the page clicking the section before). The row presses h, k and l.
